candidates.name: Dark East Bay mark
candidates.reason: Native crop shows a dense irregular ink mark without an independently traceable shoreline. No physical island identity was established; nearest guide polygon is not evidence.

candidates.name: Waterford/Kilkenny whole-basins
candidates.reason: Waterford modern dam/storage history and Kilkenny transfer/drawdown history do not support an unchanged historical whole-basin definition. Source/modern shape differences are substantial.

candidates.name: Gillis Lake whole-basin centroid
candidates.reason: East-shore label/road overprint complicates a complete outer-ring trace. The separately reviewed southern lake/stream junction is used instead, with original uncertainty retained.
